Name: Firework Launcher
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds a new object to the game, the firework launcher! It acts similarly to the flute block, but instead of playing a note, it launches a firework. You can change what type of firework is launched by interacting with the firework launcher while holding the desired firework. Fireworks can be launched an unlimited number of times from the firework launcher.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The crafting recipe for the firework launcher can be obtained from the casino.[/color][/size]
